INTROThree Cubmasters joke about how fast Cubs wear out shirts, handbooks, and den leaders.▶ Listen

And now it's the old Scoutmaster. Three Cubmasters are talking at a round table and the first one says: I don't know about you guys how you guys are doing with uniforms and everything like that. Our Cubs all have scout shirts and scout pants, but they seem to wear the shirts out in like within a year They get torn and worn out.

and the second Cubmaster pipes up and says: well, you know, our guys seem to do okay with the shirts, but it seems like within six months the handbooks are all worn out and torn to pieces. It's amazing how quick they wear things out.
